module_summary: UART receiver with AXI-Stream output: a prescale tick counter and bit counter sample rxd mid-bit, shift bits into a data register, and present bytes with valid/ready plus error flags.

anchors.name: ph
anchors.why: Bit/phase counter sequencing start, data and stop bits of a frame

anchors.name: tk
anchors.why: Prescale baud timer reloaded per bit, timing mid-bit sampling

anchors.name: acc
anchors.why: Shift register assembling received data bits LSB-first

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial receive line sampled into smp

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received byte output driven from output latch

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid, set on good stop bit, held until tready

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready clearing the output valid register

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Baud prescale setting used to reload the bit timer

anchors.name: overrun_error
anchors.why: Pulses when new byte arrives while previous still valid

anchors.name: frame_error
anchors.why: Pulses when stop bit sampled low

anchors.name: smp
anchors.why: Registered rxd sample steering start detection and bit shifting

anchors.name: step
anchors.why: Bit-time tick: timer expired while frame active, advances ph

anchors.name: park
anchors.why: Idle flag: no frame active; enables start-bit detection and busy update

anchors.name: fin_ok
anchors.why: Good stop bit: loads output latch, sets valid, checks overrun

anchors.name: mid
anchors.why: Data-bit phase decode of ph enabling shifts into acc

anchors.name: ph_echo
anchors.why: Delayed copy of ph with no consumers

groups.name: Bit timing
groups.description: Prescale timer generating mid-bit sample ticks

groups.name: Frame sequencer
groups.description: Bit counter tracking start, data and stop phases of a frame

groups.name: Receive shifter
groups.description: Samples rxd and shifts data bits into acc

groups.name: AXI-Stream output
groups.description: Output byte latch with valid/ready handshake

groups.name: Status flags
groups.description: Busy, overrun and framing error registers
